forces: #107 is a severity:high network trust boundary: an unauthenticated collector ingress would accept evidence from unidentifiable senders, and authentication must precede body work so unauthenticated input cannot drive parsing cost.
The producer and collector must not disagree about validity: only the exact generated validator can be the structural authority, which rules out any reimplemented validation.
The frozen contract's bounds are the only legitimate size authority: a collector with looser or stricter self-configured limits accepts what the producer could not emit or rejects valid events.

The ratified version policy is deliberately asymmetric: the producer binds EXACT_ONE while a separately authorized collector MAY support an explicit finite set; the version stage must enforce a set, never an open-ended semver check.

The SDK core scope gate forbids collector source in the producer package and the delivery conformance contract forbids sink collector communication, so the collector must be a dedicated zero-runtime-dependency package.
The repository topology is a ratified owner decision naming exactly four packages; landing a fifth package without amending the capability would leave the canonical spec contradicting the repository.
Rejection diagnostics and operational counters are attacker-adjacent surfaces: payload or credential leakage there is a data disclosure, and a recursive audit-event loop would amplify any failure.

the parse stage is instrumented and E2 asserts zero parse invocations at runtime
the vendored copy is byte-identical to the canonical generated artifact at scaffold time
check:generated-validator recomputes sha256 identity and fails closed on divergence
every enforced bound equals the corresponding frozen contract bound
E5 rejects an oversized body with the size diagnostic before schema runs

security_justification.trust_boundary: The ingress is the first network-adjacent trust boundary for collected evidence; it authenticates first and fails closed, and authentication identifies a sender without conferring trust.
security_justification.authority_provenance: No authority or signing logic is added or modified; the supported-version set and the bounds derive from ratified canonical sources (#75/#76 policy, frozen contract bounds) and the topology amendment cites the #343 owner decision.
security_justification.authentication_or_authorization: Introduces the authentication interface and one non-production synthetic-fixture implementation; no production credential system, secret management, or infrastructure is selected, configured, or shipped.
security_justification.audit_integrity: Every rejection carries a stable bounded diagnostic and every acceptance records admission with event identity, leaving a reviewable disposition for each occurrence.
security_justification.confidentiality: Processes synthetic fixture submissions only; diagnostics and counters are bounded, keyed by a closed vocabulary, and E8 proves no payload or credential material appears in them.
security_justification.mutation_ownership: Changes are confined to the declared owned paths: the new collector package, the package-discovery declaration, the CI workflow entries, and this change's governance artifacts.
security_justification.fail_posture: Fails closed at every stage: unreadable, malformed, or unexpected input at any stage rejects before admission and consumes no capacity.
security_justification.error_disclosure: Diagnostics are the bounded triple code, category, path; no stack traces, tokens, payloads, or environment data are emitted.
security_justification.concurrency: The ingress is a synchronous, stateless, single-threaded pipeline per submission; counters are the only shared state and are bounded increments with no ordering semantics.
security_justification.lifecycle: Runs inside the existing package validate chain and repository CI jobs; no new lifecycle stage, server, or long-running process is introduced.
security_justification.resource_retention: Parsing is bounded by the derived size stage before any allocation of schema work; no queue, buffer, or retention of submission material exists.
security_justification.retry_or_redelivery: No retry or redelivery behavior is introduced; a rejected occurrence is terminal and never retried by the ingress.
security_justification.cryptography: Does not introduce, modify, or rely upon cryptographic algorithms or keys; the synthetic authenticator compares fixture values only.
security_justification.privacy_transformation: Processes no real-user data; fixtures are synthetic adversarial test material, and no transformation of payload content occurs.
security_justification.external_security_integration: No external security integration, network service, or new tool invocation is introduced.
